name: MYS Group Co., Ltd.
summary: MYS Group Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells packaging products in China and internationally. The company offers transport, corrugated, fine, heavy, and light packaging products; label products; packaging integration services, such as packaging product design, structural design, packaging solution optimization, third-party procurement of packaging materials, and packaging product logistics distribution, as well as supplier inventory management and on-site auxiliary packaging services; and electronic functional material die-cutting products, such as cushioning pads, shock-absorbing foam, adhesive tape, protective film, dust-proof mesh, conductive insulating film, etc. MYS Group Co., Ltd.…
